prepass.instruction_timing: RGP reports no wavefronts analyzed; excluded from dynamic aggregate

fsr4.method: Instruction counts weighted by sampled instruction hits / sampled wave count, then by dispatch total waves. Core aggregate covers passes 1..12, excludes exposure, prepass, postpass and auxiliary dispatches. VOPD counts as one issue instruction; fp32 component metric separately expands its two arithmetic components.

benchmark.note: One 40-warmup/100-measured run of the public probe, separate from the RGP capture and not interleaved against L. Runtime provides context, not model or quality equivalence.
benchmark.executable_provenance: Measured public probe before minor provider-prefix/error-handling checks; executable was overwritten by the final build. Captured prototype hash and final smoke-test executable hash retained separately.

limitations: Same physical GPU and RADV backend; different frontends: FSR4 D3D12/vkd3d-proton, L Vulkan/vkhip native HIP.
FSR4 core excludes the expensive prepass and postpass; L inner core excludes fused outer stages. These are explicit dispatch subsets, not equivalent networks.
RGP instruction timing samples waves; counts are estimates weighted by dispatch waves, not hardware-wide instruction counters.
FSR4 prepass had no instruction-timing samples. No complete-upscaler non-matrix aggregate is claimed.
One patterned input sequence; no cross-model image-quality equivalence or native Windows-driver performance claim.
fsr4.actual_path: v_wmma_f32_16x16x16_fp8_fp8 in all sampled FSR4 matrix passes, including postpass; no INT8 WMMA observed

environment.loaded_provider: app-local amdxcffx64.dll; Proton system32 amdxc64.dll bridge
environment.inputs: RGBA16F patterned color, RG16F zero motion, R32F depth 0.5, four jitters; reset first frame only

l.model: preset L, optimized relaxed outer stages, native vkhip inner layers
l.note: Core is the ten inner Swin dispatches; all_matrix_stages additionally includes enc0_l and dec0_l, whose instruction counts include fused input and reconstruction-head work. Analytical exposure/post/downsample excluded. Counts estimated from sampled instruction-hit frequencies and actual dispatch wave counts.

comparison.note: All-matrix includes fused input/head work and some FP16 WMMA in L; FSR4 prepass has no WMMA. Not a comparison of model quality or equal workloads.
